def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = instance["customer_ids"][:]  # keep deterministic order
    n = len(customers)
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    hint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", n)

    cust_set = set(customers)

    # --- helper: route cost with depot ends ---
    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        c += matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        return c

    # --- helper: try merge i-route and j-route if i is at an end and j at an end ---
    def can_merge(r_i, r_j, i, j):
        if r_i == r_j:
            return None
        # r_i ends contain i
        if not r_i:
            return None
        if not r_j:
            return None
        i_is_left = (r_i[0] == i)
        i_is_right = (r_i[-1] == i)
        j_is_left = (r_j[0] == j)
        j_is_right = (r_j[-1] == j)
        if not (i_is_left or i_is_right) or not (j_is_left or j_is_right):
            return None
        return (i_is_left, i_is_right, j_is_left, j_is_right)

    # --- Clarke-Wright savings construction (deterministic) ---
    # Start with singleton routes
    routes = [[i] for i in customers]
    loads = [demands[i] for i in customers]
    active = [True] * len(routes)
    route_of = {i: idx for idx, i in enumerate(customers)}

    # Precompute for faster savings sorting deterministically
    cust_list = customers[:]  # deterministic order
    savings = []
    for a_i in range(len(cust_list)):
        i = cust_list[a_i]
        for a_j in range(a_i + 1, len(cust_list)):
            j = cust_list[a_j]
            # Standard savings score
            s = matrix[depot][i] + matrix[depot][j] - matrix[i][j]
            # Deterministic tie-break: higher s, then smaller min(i,j), then smaller max
            key1 = i if i < j else j
            key2 = j if i < j else i
            savings.append((s, key1, key2, i, j))
